name: gooey-morph
title: Gooey Morph
description: Bars fly in Tetris-style, land as a row, then melt into a word through a gooey blur-and-threshold morph.
useWhen: A title reveal should feel liquid: shapes fuse and hand their mass to the word instead of crossfading.
You want a two-act entrance: a kinetic bar build, then the melt.
The word is short and set in a heavy display face, so the goo has solid masses to fuse.
avoidWhen: You need a plain text entrance without the shape build-up: use soft-blur-in or mask-reveal-up.
The text is long or thin-stroked: the blur-threshold eats thin strokes.
The style should be crisp and geometric, not liquid: use kinetic-center-build.
author: Remocn
